usage: 蘿蔔 usually refers to a white root vegetable used in many Cantonese dishes.
It can be eaten raw, pickled, or cooked in soups and stews.
When buying, look for firm and smooth skin to ensure freshness.
蘿蔔 can mean either daikon radish or other similar types of radish.
It is a common ingredient in winter dishes because it helps warm the body.
